elements.manual_reason: The close-up foreground puppet drops down and exits below the frame, so it is absent from the end frame; box marks its exit path at the bottom edge.
elements.label: Close-up foreground mascot puppet dropping out of frame
Small full-body mascot figure on green base (revealed)

pattern.description: A large close-up of the mascot in front of the 'LEARN CHESS' title drops rapidly downward with heavy motion blur, exiting the bottom of the frame and revealing a small full-body version of the same character standing on a base beneath the static title.
pattern.why_premium: Gravity-driven exit of the foreground subject reframes from close-up to hero lockup without a cut; the motion blur sells speed and the static title anchors the composition, giving a playful, tactile end-card resolve.

build_hint.gsap: Title stays static. gsap.to('.closeup', {yPercent: 120, duration: 0.13, ease: 'power3.in', filter: 'blur(6px)'}); small figure already in place behind (z-index below) or gsap.set visible at the same moment; optional tiny settle on the small figure with back.out.
build_hint.remotion: const y = interpolate(frame, [0, 4], [0, 120], {easing: Easing.in(Easing.cubic), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); closeup style transform: translateY(y%) plus filter blur proportional to velocity; render the small figure underneath, static.

notes: Live-action/puppet compositing on green background. Before the drop the close-up wobbles/turns (energy from frame 1). Camera verdict none. Spectrogram shows a downward sweep around 82.72s that may be a whoosh, but no SFX candidates were given, so none reviewed. The close-up element uses manual_box because it has left the frame by the end frame.
